fields.label: Statement
fields.value: When a favourable mutation sweeps to fixation, it reduces genetic variation at closely linked neutral sites, and the reduction is larger the tighter the linkage relative to the strength of selection.

fields.label: Notation
fields.value: the relative heterozygosity H_{after}/H_{before} at a neutral site at recombination fraction c is an increasing function of c/s that tends to 0 as c/s \to 0; the affected region has a width of order s in recombination units, up to logarithmic factors in N

fields.label: Notation

fields.label: Proposed test
fields.value: Test for a positive correlation between neutral diversity and local recombination rate across the genome, and for diversity troughs around sites of recent adaptive substitution, while modelling background selection as the alternative.
